question: Why is metronidazole short, and what do we do?

steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals

steps.finding: 11 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug. Every row is in a shared unit of use.

explanation.headline: FDA's records show metronidazole injection has been on the shortage list since 2022-01-13 and remains Current as of 2026-10-16

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows metronidazole injection from Baxter Healthcare has been Current since its initial posting on 2022-01-13 and was last updated on 2026-10-16.
The shortage has been on FDA's list for 57 months as of 2026-10-21.
Baxter Healthcare Corporation's plant at FEI 1416980 received an OAI classification on 2024-08-01 and again on 2026-04-02, with a Warning Letter issued on 2026-09-29.
Another Baxter plant at FEI 2618677 has a history of multiple OAI classifications from 2010 through 2016, with the most recent inspection VAI on 2024-07-19.
Corvale East holds 139 units of B. Braun metronidazole 500 mg/100 mL solution with 9.6 days on hand, while Corvale General holds 338 units with 21.7 days on hand.

The recommended action is to transfer 64 units of 500 mg/100 mL solution from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would bring Corvale East to 14 days of supply while Corvale General maintains two weeks.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
